title: Your first encounter in noctune — iOS

headline: Choose a patient
and templates.
scenes.narration: On iPhone, tap Record and choose your patient. Check the SOAP and discharge templates before you begin. noctune includes general templates, with community and custom templates available for other workflows. For this visit, we'll use the general templates.

headline: Record the
appointment.
scenes.narration: Tap Start Recording. Hold Pause when you need a break, then tap Resume recording to continue. When you're finished, hold Finish and transcribe. You can also choose an existing audio file from your phone.

headline: Upload, then
review the draft.
scenes.narration: Once uploaded, your recording is processed into draft notes. Processing continues after you leave the screen. Here is Mochi's example draft.

headline: Review against
the transcript.
scenes.narration: Read the SOAP note and check the patient details, findings, and plan. Open Transcript and tap a passage to jump to that point in the audio. The draft is a starting point for your clinical review.

headline: Correct, preview,
and save.
scenes.narration: Tap Edit and make any corrections. Here, we're updating a phrase in the plan. Preview shows how the finished note will read. Then tap Save and check your change. Saving does not complete the encounter.

headline: Review discharge
before sending.
scenes.narration: Review the Discharge tab, then open the email composer. Every account can send discharge notes. Without Nest, no reply is the default. Check the recipient and reply address before sending. This example stays unsent.

headline: Complete after
your review.
scenes.narration: To complete the encounter without sending an email, tap the arrow beside the email button. Choose Mark as complete. Do this only after your review is finished.

headline: Keep follow-up
with the visit.
scenes.narration: With noctune Nest, clients reply through a private relay address. Your personal email stays hidden, and replies stay linked to the encounter. Open Messages to follow up with the visit in context.
